message:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The fix adds a check `LIKELY(ip + cur < iend)` before calling `LIT_PRICE(ip+cur)` which calls `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost`. Without this check, when `ip + cur >= iend`, the code reads `literals[u]` from beyond the valid input buffer, which contains uninitialized memory.

Let me look at the context around line 1216 in the current (vulnerable) code:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/zstd && sed -n '1180,1260p' lib/compress/zstd_opt.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
